safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the patient has had prior similar reactions helps gauge risk of recurrent/severe allergy and informs longer-term planning (e.g., need for allergy referral, epinephrine auto-injector education). In this encounter the clinician already advises urgent ambulance/hospital evaluation for possible anaphylaxis, so omission is unlikely to change immediate safety actions but may reduce completeness of risk stratification and follow-up planning.
